bear_assumptions: USD 18.75 normalized forward EPS at 20x as cloud growth slows and accelerated AI capacity depreciation pressures margins.
base_assumptions: USD 20.00 normalized forward EPS at 25x as Azure and Microsoft 365 remain strong while infrastructure costs constrain incremental margins.
